chart.alt: Two charts. Line graph: average price of a home in three cities, 2000–2024, in thousands of dollars. Ardmore: 120 in 2000, 165 in 2006, 150 in 2012, 210 in 2018, 290 in 2024. Bellport: 95, 110, 118, 130, 145. Carrow: 140, 200, 190, 240, 260. Table: percentage of people aged 25–34 who owned their home. Ardmore: 58% in 2000, 31% in 2024. Bellport: 52%, 49%. Carrow: 61%, 38%.

document.title: Home prices and young home owners
document.question:
The graph below shows the average price of a home in three cities between 2000 and 2024. The table shows the percentage of people aged 25–34 who owned their home in the same cities in 2000 and 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
